offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pool and spa equipment, including pumps, filters, heaters, sanitizers, lighting and automation controls, sold mainly to pool builders, service companies and residential pool owners. Products are made in company facilities and sold through distributors, retailers and direct accounts.

primary_products.value: pool pumps; pool filters; pool heaters; sanitization systems; pool automation controls

customer_segment.value: B2B: pool builders, pool service companies, equipment distributors; B2C: residential pool and spa owners who buy through retail channels

end_markets.value: residential pools; commercial pools; spas; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: pool and spa equipment sold to distributors, retailers and pool builders

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds pumps, filters, heaters and controls, sold to distributors and retailers; brand owner: markets its own equipment brands sold through dealers and retail channels

geography_served.value: global: North America as the main market, plus Europe, Latin America, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: pumps, filters, heaters, sanitization and automation controls for pools and spas

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent pool equipment distributors and dealers; third-party retail: pool supply retail chains and independent pool stores; direct sales: direct accounts with large pool builders and national service companies
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety and energy efficiency rules for electrical pool equipment, such as UL safety listings and US DOE pump efficiency standards

notes: Business details are from general knowledge of the company and may not reflect its latest product mix or channels.
